payload.comment:
The reporting stage is numerically consistent and internally coherent. All arithmetic cross-checks pass: (1) Confusion-matrix row sums match per-class supports (total 7,180); diagonal 6,375/7,180 = 0.887883 matches reported accuracy. (2) Per-class precision/recall/F1 verified against the matrix for classes 0, 5, 7, 8 — all correct. (3) abstain_rate + test_coverage = 1.0; selective_risk = 1 − accuracy_on_covered; human_review_count = 7180 × 0.439276 ≈ 3154. (4) accuracy_delta = 0.887883 − 0.821309 = 0.066574; common_seed and split_fingerprint match across baseline and agentic reports. (5) ood_auroc 0.979091 = mean of three predictive-entropy test AUROCs. (6) baseline_met_or_exceeded = true is correct. No deterministic errors found.

However, several methodological and presentation concerns warrant attention (severity: warning):

1. Val/test accuracy gap (~11 pp: 0.9972 vs 0.8879) signals substantial distribution shift or overfitting; the reporting surfaces the numbers but does not include a diagnostic discussion or confidence interval to contextualise the gap.
2. Test coverage (56.07%) is 24 pp below the 80% validation target, meaning the entropy threshold calibrated on validation does not transfer; 3,154 samples (44%) are routed to human review, materially reducing pipeline utility.
3. OOD evaluation is restricted to unit-scale Gaussian noise at three severity levels; semantic OOD shifts (staining variation, tissue-type differences, scanner artefacts) are unassessed, so ood_pass=true should be interpreted narrowly.
4. Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall is 0.508 (F1 0.647); 105 samples misclassified as debris and 71 as smooth muscle — the worst-performing class and a clinically relevant confusion.
5. The comparison report surfaces only the accuracy delta; the macro-F1 delta (0.855476 − 0.750857 = 0.104619) is available in both artefacts but not reported, and no statistical significance test or confidence interval accompanies either delta.
6. Rationale strings in best_configuration, train_config, and trial configs are truncated with '…', limiting full auditability of design justification.
7. early_stopping_patience changed from 1 (search trials) to 3 (final train_config) without an explicit justification note.
8. Balanced accuracy (0.8665) trails overall accuracy (0.8879) by 2.1 pp, indicating class-imbalance-driven performance masking that is noted but not further decomposed.

None of these constitute arithmetic or schema errors in the reporting artefacts themselves; they are methodological limitations and presentation gaps that should be acknowledged in any downstream use of the dossier. The reporting faithfully and correctly presents the underlying results.
